purpose: Provide official RIS consolidated royalty-article text where the publication PDF acquired through the ordinary instrument-chain workflow has no usable text layer. These overrides supplement evidence only and do not select the controlling instrument or release a treaty result.

Kuba / Cuba.reason: Official publication treaty PDFs have an unusable text layer for deterministic Article 12 extraction; RIS provides the consolidated Article 12 as official HTML.

Marokko / Morocco.reason: Official publication treaty PDFs have an unusable text layer for deterministic Article 12 extraction; RIS provides the consolidated Article 12 as official HTML.

release_constraints: An override is an additional official evidence source only; it does not establish which treaty instrument controls.
The override registry must never contain a hard-coded treaty rate or released legal conclusion.
Only URLs on the existing Austrian official-source allowlist may be acquired.
A partner remains legally unreviewed and projection-released false after override acquisition.
These Article 12 overrides do not imply Article 10 or Article 11 evidence completeness.
